capabilities: Generate an index note for a target folder with links to all nested files
Create one Markdown heading per subfolder level
Exclude files, folders, or extensions by name or extension
Configure index filename, location, and header with {{folderName}} placeholders
Trigger generation from settings, a modal, command palette, or file explorer context menu
disambiguation: Not a table of contents for a single note's headings; it indexes a folder's files and subfolders into one note.
extras: All processing is local with no network requests or telemetry; the generated note is overwritten by default, but overwrite can be turned off to preserve manual edits.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate an index note that lists all files and subfolders under a folder with links.
summary: Folder index generator that creates a hierarchical table-of-contents note with headings and links for every file and subfolder in a directory.
